observations: Photo 0: a used petrol car engine out of a vehicle, sitting on the floor of a parts yard, photographed from the front at an angle.

Photo 0: it looks like a V-type engine with the top cover removed, showing coil packs, injector wiring, a throttle body, intake hoses, an air filter box on the left and an oil filler cap on the right.
Photo 0: belt pulleys and an idler are on the front face; the harness is still attached and a yellow paint mark sits on a bracket.
Photo 0: no brand logo, engine cover lettering, engine code stamp or sticker is readable anywhere in the photo.
Photo 0: other parts lie nearby, including a gearbox or axle hub in the lower left, so it is unclear what is included.
Photo 0: one photo only, watermarked 'posted on Jiji' and with a dealer name, plus a phone camera stamp; no running clip.

identity.kind: used petrol V-type car engine (make and engine code not readable)

claims.evidence: No Lexus or Toyota logo, engine cover or engine code is visible in photo 0; the identity rests on the seller's words only.
Origin cannot be seen in a photo, and the seller's text also says direct from Belgium.
No import paperwork shown; it also conflicts with 'Japan engine' in the same advert.
Photo 0 is a still of a loose engine; no clip of it running.
A loose engine has no odometer; nothing in photo 0 shows mileage.
No close photos of gasket lines, head bolts or the oil.

risks.risk: The engine is not the Lexus LX460 engine claimed; a different engine code is worth a very different amount.
risks.proof: A sharp close photo of the engine code stamped on the block, and the engine cover with its lettering.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced; code required before any price

risks.risk: Engine does not run, knocks, or has low compression.
risks.proof: A clip of the engine started on a stand or in a car, with sound, from cold start to idle, plus a compression reading per cylinder.
risks.if_unproven: as not working, a core for parts

risks.risk: Engine has been opened or has a blown head gasket.
risks.proof: Close photos of head to block joints, head bolts, and the oil under the filler cap and on the dipstick.

risks.risk: Ancillaries missing or not included (ECU, starter, alternator, the gearbox seen beside it).
risks.proof: Photos of all sides of the engine and a written list of what is included.

proof_requests: Sharp close photo of the engine code stamped on the block.
Photo of the engine with its top cover fitted showing the brand lettering.
Clip of the engine running with sound, from start to idle.
Photos of all sides and a list of what is included.
Photo of the oil under the filler cap and on the dipstick.
response.reason: Photo 0 shows a used petrol car engine but no brand or engine code can be read, and the Lexus LX460 claim rests on the seller's words alone; the engine code sets the price, so it must be shown before even a worst case price.
